papers.title: Triple Products of Correlated Multivariate Hermite Polynomials
papers.summary: Stochastic Galerkin schemes (SGS) are used to approximate solutions to differential equations with stochastic parameters. In particular, they express the solution with an infinite orthogonal functional basis of the parameter space and derive a deterministic system of PDEs; the solution of this deterministic system can be used to produce a {surrogate} approximation of the original stochastic equations. When the parameters are correlated, the infinite series representation of the solution does not provably converge for all joint distributions; further, classic decorrelating transformations (e.g., Roseblatt) often introduce known numerical instabilities. Rahman (2017) established convergence in probability and distribution for correlated {Gaussian} parameters when the basis functionals are {multivariate Hermite polynomials} (MHPs), where these polynomials are only {weakly orthogonal} with respect to the underlying joint density. Due to weak orthogonality, the $N$th moments of MHPs introduced during Galerkin projection do not trivially decompose into products of one-dimensional expectations and have no closed-form expression for $N > 2$; consequently, these moments are typically estimated via brute-force sampling and quickly become prohibitively expensive to compute. In this paper, we introduce and prove several foundational results for MHPs. These results culminate in an equation that can be used to calculate the $N = 3$ moments (triple products) exactly, whose implementation dramatically reduces the computational bottleneck otherwise inherent to SGS with correlated Gaussian parameters.
papers.title_ja: 相関を持つ多変量エルミート多項式の三重積
papers.summary_ja: 確定的ガレルキン法（SGS）を用いた確率微分方程式のサロゲートモデル構築において、相関ガウスパラメータの場合の計算ボトルネックを解決する手法を提案する。従来の非相関化変換は数値的不安定性を招き、多変量エルミート多項式（MHP）の3次モーメント（三重積）は閉じた形での計算式が存在しなかった。本論文ではMHPに関する基礎的な数学的結果を証明し、三重積を厳密に計算する方程式を導出する。これにより、従来は乱数サンプリングに頼っていた計算コストを劇的に低減し、効率的なサロゲートモデルの構築を可能にする。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデル構築の計算効率化と数学的基礎の強化に直結するため

papers.title: A Priori Estimation of the Non-Linear Compression Potential and Quantification of Autoencoder Non-Linearity in Turbulent Flows
papers.summary: Data-driven reduced-order modelling (ROM) of turbulent flows is based on an efficient and physical low-dimensional representation of the flow process. Such a dimension reduction can be achieved using proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) or non-linear autoencoders. Capturing the inherent non-linearities in turbulent flows offers the potential for improved compression rates. This work proposes the local tangent residual (LTR) as an a priori estimate of the potential benefit of non-linear dimension reduction for a given dataset. The LTR is based on the local geometry of the data points, requiring neither prior model training nor the definition of a threshold parameter. For all datasets investigated in this work, namely, two vortex street cases and the turbulent wake flow of a wind turbine, the dominant trends in autoencoder compression performance are reproduced by the proposed LTR. The results are further contextualised through the decoder linearisation error (DLE). The DLE quantifies the non-linearity of the trained decoder by comparing it to a linearised surrogate model, which enables physical interpretability of the non-linearities. Together, a large non-linear compression potential in the turbulent flow, as quantified by the LTR, is corroborated by a large DLE, i.e., a pronounced non-linearity captured in the trained autoencoder. The LTR thus enables practitioners in turbulent flow modelling to determine a priori whether non-linear compression is worthwhile, avoiding the substantial computational cost of autoencoder architecture search and hyperparameter tuning in cases where POD already suffices.
papers.title_ja: 乱流における非線形圧縮ポテンシャルの事前推定とオートエンコーダーの非線形性の定量化
papers.summary_ja: 乱流のデータ駆動型縮約モデル（ROM）において、非線形オートエンコーダーによる次元削減の効果を事前に見積もる手法を提案する。データ点の局所幾何構造に基づく「局所接線残差（LTR）」を用いることで、モデル訓練や閾値設定なしに非線形圧縮の潜在的利益を評価できる。さらに、デコーダーの線形化誤差（DLE）により学習済みモデルの非線形性を定量化し、物理的な解釈可能性を高める。これにより、PODで十分である場合にオートエンコーダーの計算コストを回避し、効率的なモデル選択が可能になる。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルとサロゲートモデルの効率化・評価手法に直結

papers.title: The Cost of Saying Hello: An Empirical Study of Handshake Overhead in AI Agent Communication Protocols
papers.summary: Every interaction between AI agents begins with a handshake: the initiating agent must locate its counterpart, learn what it can do, and establish a session before the first useful message can be sent. Surveys of agent communication protocols name handshake overhead as an efficiency criterion, yet none report measurements. This paper presents the first empirical, phase-decomposed benchmark of the handshake in three major agent protocols: MCP (in both its 2025 initialize and 2026 discover eras), A2A, and ACP. Using each protocol's official SDK, we instrument every request for round trips, per-phase latency, wire bytes, and token cost across cold-start, warm-repeat, capability-mismatch, and degraded-metadata scenarios (N=50 per cell, on loopback and under an emulated 50 ms RTT). Round-trip count dominates handshake cost. A legacy MCP handshake takes three round trips and 230 ms at 50 ms RTT; A2A needs one round trip and 61.0 ms. Round trips are not the whole bill: when an LLM reads the counterpart's metadata, handshake cost scales with the counterpart's capability inventory at 24-107 tokens per capability, so a 200-capability counterpart spends 11% of a 200k-token context window before the agent reads its own task. MCP's own 2026 revision cuts its handshake from three round trips to two and, with era pinning, to zero on warm reconnects, protocol evolution that corroborates the cost we measure. We release the full harness, raw data, and analysis at https://github.com/pvarshh/handshake-benchmark.
papers.title_ja: 「こんにちは」の代償：AIエージェント通信プロトコルにおけるハンドシェイクオーバーヘッドの実証的研究
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、MCP、A2A、ACPという主要なAIエージェント間通信プロトコルのハンドシェイク（初期化）コストを初めて実証的にベンチマークしたものである。ラウンドトリップ数、レイテンシ、ワイヤバイト数、トークンコストを測定し、ラウンドトリップ数がコストの主要因であることを示した。特にLLMが相手のメタデータを読み込む際のトークン消費は、機能リストの規模に比例し、200機能の場合に200kトークンコンテキストの11%を消費することが判明した。MCPの2026年改訂版ではラウンドトリップ削減によりコストが低下しており、プロトコル進化がコスト削減に寄与することを裏付けている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と効率化、トークンコスト評価に直結する実務的データを提供

papers.title: baseVultra: Compact Nonlinear Recurrence with Reallocated Capacity
papers.summary: Nonlinear recurrent networks remain useful for streaming sequence modeling, yet gated cell design is still dominated by LSTM and GRU. We study whether recurrent computation can be reallocated away from gate transforms and toward candidate generation. We propose baseVultra, a compact recurrent cell that concentrates the dense recurrent budget on a single H x H candidate-generation matrix, while replacing recurrent gate matrices with O(H) diagonal interactions. The candidate update combines this dense branch with two low-rank auxiliary branches, an EMA cache, and learnable output blending; the gates additionally receive lightweight second-order access to h_{t-2} through diagonal terms. On TinyShakespeare character-level language modeling, baseVultra achieves a validation loss of 1.594 in the compact one-layer 200K setting, compared with 1.604 for a parameter-matched LSTM and 1.616 for a parameter-matched GRU, while its dense recurrent matrix-vector computation is about 54% of GRU under matched hidden size for this configuration. On text8, a roughly 45x larger benchmark, baseVultra is competitive with full-gate cells (1.854 bpc vs. 1.849 for GRU and 1.837 for LSTM). On formal-language probes, the largest gains appear under constrained hidden-state capacity (0.991 vs. 0.761 GRU and 0.691 LSTM OOD2 accuracy on Counter at H=16) and vanish as hidden size grows. These results characterize where and when candidate-focused recurrent capacity allocation helps: the benefit is concentrated in compact regimes, while full-gate cells remain competitive at scale.
papers.title_ja: baseVultra: 再割り当てされた容量を持つコンパクトな非線形再帰
papers.summary_ja: LSTMやGRUに代わるコンパクトな再帰型ニューラルネットワークセル「baseVultra」を提案する。ゲート変換への計算資源を削減し、候補生成マトリクスに集中させることで、パラメータ数と計算量を効率化する。TinyShakespeare等のベンチマークにおいて、同等のパラメータ数を持つLSTMやGRUと比較し、特にコンパクトな設定下で低い検証損失と高い計算効率を示した。大規模なtext8や形式言語プローブでは、隠れ層サイズが大きい場合、従来のフルゲートセルと競争力があることを確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化・効率化の観点で高関連

papers.title: Why Constrained Updates Still Forget: A Functional-Path Analysis of Continual SFT
papers.summary: Supervised fine-tuning adapts language models to specialized tasks but can disrupt previously acquired behavior. Existing approaches constrain parameters, gradients, or replay objectives, yet the connection between the protected object, the intervening trajectory, and retained outputs remains unclear. We develop a functional-path account that decomposes old-loss changes along realized updates into the controlled direction, gradient staleness, probe mismatch, and finite-step effects. The account yields a conditional refresh budget and identifies the restoring direction supplied by informative replay. Matched QLoRA interventions separate constraint granularity from placement before or after Adam: placement strongly affects retention across the studied code-label audits, whereas the granularity interaction depends on the endpoint. Checkpointed generation separates endpoint recovery from higher sampled-path accuracy, and matched replay schedules reveal loss exposure concealed by final scores. A sequential-task comparison extends this distinction to backward transfer: subspace regularization and projection improve average retention while trading off different old tasks; supervised replay protects both more consistently in this setting. Additional response interfaces distinguish content gains from exact-response retention. These findings connect update-level protection to task-wise behavior and motivate mitigation through explicit functional anchors, trajectory evaluation, and joint old/new auditing.
papers.title_ja: 制約付き更新でも忘却が生じる理由：継続的SFTの機能経路分析
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデルの継続的ファインチューニングにおける「忘却」現象を、機能経路の観点から分解・分析する。既存のパラメータや勾配の制約手法では、保護対象と出力維持の因果関係が不明確なため、更新経路を制御方向・勾配の陳腐化・プローブ不一致・有限ステップ効果に分解する枠組みを提案する。QLoRAを用いた実験により、制約の適用位置（Adamの前か後か）が保持率に与える影響が粒度より大きいことを示し、チェックポイント生成やリプレイスケジュールの比較を通じて、最終スコアでは見えない損失の露出を可視化する。さらに、後方転移の観点からサブスペース正則化と監督付きリプレイのトレードオフを比較し、明示的な機能アンカーと経路評価による緩和策の必要性を論じる。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・RAG/エージェント設計の基盤となる継続学習と忘却対策に直結する手法論

papers.title: AI Mindmeld: A Latent Interconnect Protocol
papers.summary: LLMs can act as scientific agents using tools to consult specialists and run experiments. Yet specialist information must enter their context, generally as text, images, audio or video: a bottleneck between models with rich, high-dimensional representations. We advocate direct representation exchange: a mindmeld conveying many properties, including information an LLM would not think to request. It should be extensible to new specialists, flexible across questions and tasks, and compositional across independently connected specialists without joint training. The Latent Interconnect Protocol (LIP) learns connectors mapping specialist representations into LLM internal states. Training only connectors keeps this practical as LLMs grow and evolve. We connect three protein and three small molecule specialists to Gemma 3 (4B and 12B parameters) and Kimi K2.6 (1T total, 32B active), freezing all pretrained models. Independently trained connectors provide useful information without changing the LLM or existing connectors, supporting familiar and new question types about unseen objects. We demonstrate zero-shot transfer to cross-domain tasks without joint training. Task performance and compositionality generally improve with LLM capability, with especially strong gains in zero-shot task transfer. Limitations remain: current LLMs were not trained for specialist representations as native inputs; access does not ensure reliable interpretation, integration or use in reasoning. We call on specialist developers to provide consistent representation interfaces and, especially, on LLM developers to train models to receive, combine and reason with these inputs. These efforts could expand scientific agents' information while preserving conventional tools' flexibility. Data, pretrained connectors, and code for training, evaluation and interactive inference: https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld
papers.title_ja: AI Mindmeld: 潜在相互接続プロトコル
papers.summary_ja: LLMが専門モデルからテキストではなく高次元の潜在表現を直接受け取ることで、情報伝達のボトルネックを解消する「潜在相互接続プロトコル（LIP）」を提案する。LLM本体は凍結し、専門モデルの表現をLLM内部状態へ写像するコネクタのみを学習することで、既存モデルとの統合や新タスクへのゼロショット転移を可能にする。タンパク質や小分子の専門モデルをGemma 3やKimi K2.6に接続し、独立学習したコネクタが新しい質問や未見オブジェクトに対して有用な情報を提供することを示した。LLMの能力向上に伴いタスク性能と構成可能性が改善し、特にゼロショット転移で顕著な向上が見られた。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMと外部モデルの効率的な統合・推論強化に関わる手法

papers.title: Astro2Method: Benchmarking LLMs on Machine Learning Method Selection in Astronomy
papers.summary: Machine learning (ML) is increasingly used in astronomy, but choosing a suitable method for a scientific problem often requires expertise in both astronomy and ML. Large language models (LLMs) could help astronomers make such choices, yet this ability remains underexplored in existing benchmarks. We introduce Astro2Method, a benchmark of 500 expert-reviewed binary questions from 346 astronomy papers (2024/01-2026/06), based on clear performance differences and complete (Easy) or partial (Hard) explanations from the authors. Across five LLMs, direct prompting achieves 87.50-92.55% accuracy on Easy questions but only 58.87-64.52% on Hard. Using historical papers, neither retrieval-augmented generation nor most agent methods with additional reasoning or retrieval (including ReAct, Self-Ask, and CRITIC) bring consistent improvement. Agents required to search the web improve accuracy mainly when they find the papers the questions are based on, with no consistent improvement otherwise. Providing the source paper's pipeline description with method names masked improves Hard accuracy, matching or exceeding web search. Together, these results suggest that relevant experimental information helps distinguish ML methods, but inferring it from related studies and domain knowledge remains challenging for LLMs in astronomy.
papers.title_ja: Astro2Method: 天文学における機械学習手法選択におけるLLMのベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: 天文学分野における機械学習手法の選択能力を評価する新ベンチマーク「Astro2Method」を提案する。500問の二択問題を用い、5つのLLMの性能を比較した結果、簡単な質問では高精度だが、複雑な質問では精度が低下することが示された。RAGやReActなどのエージェント手法は一貫した改善をもたらさず、ソース論文の情報を提供することで精度が向上することが判明した。これは、関連する実験情報に基づく推論がLLMにとって依然として困難であることを示唆している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのRAG・エージェント設計と評価手法の両方に直結する

papers.title: AQL-Lite: Enabling Efficient Knowledge Acquisition for Arabic LLMs via Data-Centric Continual Pretraining
papers.summary: Training Arabic large language models faces challenges from noisy web data, dialectal variation, and the high cost of continual pretraining (CPT). We introduce AQL-Lite (AQL: Arabic Quality Language), a time- and resource-efficient framework for adapting a multilingual LLM to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). AQL-Lite couples a quality-first curation pipeline (structural cleaning, heuristic and model-based filtering, MSA selection, and deduplication) with a partial-parameter CPT recipe that trains RS-LoRA adapters across the network together with the last eight transformer blocks and the embedding matrix, under layer-wise learning rates. At a matched 1B-token budget, CPT on AQL-curated data raises a four-benchmark Arabic mean by 3.51 points over CPT on raw web text, which yields no gain over the base model. In a controlled 5B-token comparison, AQL-Lite recovers 94% of the gain of full-parameter CPT (mean 73.19 vs. 73.58) in 52% of the wall-clock time and outperforms adapter-only baselines on every benchmark, and a component ablation shows that adapters, unfrozen blocks, and embedding training each contribute. Scaled to 40B MSA tokens and instruction-tuned on one million examples, the resulting 12B model scores 75.3 on the seven-benchmark Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2 (OALL v2) suite. These results suggest that partial-parameter CPT on a carefully curated corpus is a practical route to efficient MSA adaptation.
papers.title_ja: AQL-Lite: データ中心の継続事前学習によるアラビア語LLMの効率的知識取得
papers.summary_ja: アラビア語LLMの訓練におけるノイズやコスト問題を解決するため、高品質データキュレーションと部分パラメータ継続事前学習（CPT）を組み合わせるフレームワークAQL-Liteを提案する。RS-LoRAアダプタと最終層・埋め込み行列の学習により、フルパラメータCPTの94%の性能を52%の時間で達成した。さらに、40Bトークン規模での訓練により、12BモデルがOpen Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2で75.3点を記録し、効率的な適応手法として実用性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化・推論高速化・量子化への関心に直結する部分パラメータ学習手法

papers.title: Consistency Is Not Validity: Self-Rewarded Moral Argumentation Makes Language Models Decisive but Pliable
papers.summary: LLMs are increasingly consulted for moral judgment. We aim to improve performance on such tasks by rewarding good arguments, on the premise that arguing well increases the likelihood of judging well. We train a reinforcement learning policy initialized from a state-of-the-art language model in a self-judged tournament with masked thinking: the generated arguments are judged pairwise on argument quality by the policy itself. As an empirical basis, we extract authentic dilemmas from classic novels, using a logic solver to verify that each constitutes a conflict. We show that our judge rates argument quality like human annotators, and the policy then adopts the language register that it rewards. Testing on the external benchmarks MoralChoice, ELEPHANT, and MORABLES, we find that the policy becomes more decisive and invariant to the order in which options are presented, but sycophancy and reframing remain a challenge to validity. Two ablation studies with synthetic dilemmas and unmasked thinking match the reordering gains, but show a weaker register shift and higher sycophancy. We conclude that consistency is not validity: consistency under reordering can be optimized without improving the moral judgment it is meant to signal.
papers.title_ja: 一貫性は妥当性ではない：自己報酬型道徳的議論により言語モデルは決断的になるが、柔軟（従順）になる
papers.summary_ja: 強化学習を用いて、LLMが自己評価によるトーナメント形式で道徳的議論の質を高める手法を提案する。古典小説から抽出したジレンマを用い、論理ソルバーで検証した上で、モデルが人間の評価に近い議論品質を判定できることを示した。外部ベンチマークでは、選択肢の順序に対する不変性（一貫性）は向上したが、迎合性や再構成による妥当性の低下という課題が残存する。一貫性の最適化は、本来示すべき道徳的判断の妥当性を必ずしも向上させないことを結論づけている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの強化学習・評価手法・ハルシネーション対策に直結

papers.title: Probing and Steering for Safety-Relevant Behaviours in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Activation probes are computed directions in a language model's residual stream, used both to detect safety-relevant behaviours and, by adding their direction back into the stream, to steer them. We explore how the main design choices behind such probes interact, within one pipeline, on one model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and across three behaviours: deception, high-stakes awareness and sycophancy. The pipeline crosses two estimators (difference-of-means and logistic regression) with three token-pooling schemes (last, mean and learned attention), selects appropriate layers to detect or steer a behaviour, and evaluates every direction twice: as a detector of the behaviour, and as a steering vector to push outputs towards the behaviour. Prior work read together suggests a read/write dissociation, in which logistic regression reads (detects) best but difference-of-means directions write (steer) best. We find that it holds for deception and high-stakes but not for sycophancy, where the pattern reverses. The reversal appears to follow partially from the data rather than from the estimators. The best pooling technique and the layer choice depend on the behaviour and data, and the layer that steers best can sit well before the layer that detects best. The right steering metric to use between changing a model's perception and eliciting behaviour depends on the task - and the two can disagree outright. The exported probes and directions power an interactive interface through which a user can score and steer text directly.
papers.title_ja: 大規模言語モデルにおける安全性関連行動の探査と誘導
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、LLMの残差ストリームにおける活性化プローブを用いた安全性関連行動（欺瞞、高リスク認識、迎合性）の検出と誘導手法をLlama-3.1-8B-Instruct上で検証した。推定手法（平均差とロジスティック回帰）とトークンプーリング方式の組み合わせが、行動検出と出力誘導の性能に与える影響を分析し、従来の「読み書き分離」の仮説がすべての行動で成立しないことを示した。特に迎合性ではパターンが逆転し、最適な層や指標が行動やデータに依存することが判明した。最後に、これらのプローブを活用してテキストを直接スコアリング・誘導するインタラクティブなインターフェースを実装した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部構造解析と安全制御は、ユーザーのLLM効率化・実務応用の関心に直結する。

papers.title: LLM2Cert: LLM Synthesis of Certificates with SMT/Lean Verification
papers.summary: Lyapunov functions and barrier certificates give state-space guarantees of stability and safety, but synthesizing and verifying them---especially for nonlinear, high-dimensional systems---remains an open challenge. Existing pipelines verify candidates with numerical solvers (sum-of-squares programs), interval methods, or satisfiability-modulo-theories (SMT) solvers, which often require relaxations, are conservative, or scale poorly with model dimension and nonlinearity. These limitations have also shaped benchmark design: standard test suites are dominated by low-dimensional polynomial systems chosen to suit what solvers can handle rather than what engineering applications require. We address both sides of this challenge. First, we introduce DynaCertBench, a benchmark of 105 instances: 80 non-redundant systems curated from the literature, extended with high-dimensional and control-constrained variants and new nonlinearly coupled systems, comprehensively spanning stability, region-of-attraction, forward-invariance, and safety tasks. Second, we present LLM2Cert, an LLM-driven framework that synthesizes candidate certificates and verifies them against their proof obligations: each obligation is routed to an SMT solver or directly to the Lean Proof-Repair agent. On DynaCertBench, LLM2Cert verifies 81 of 105 instances ($77.1\%$), a $17.1$ percentage point improvement over one-shot proposal without feedback. On the 81 fixed certificates, LLM2Cert verifies 22 that All-SMT leaves unresolved. Code and data are available at https://github.com/FormalCert-AI/llm2cert.
papers.title_ja: LLM2Cert: SMT/Lean検証によるLLMを用いた証明書の合成
papers.summary_ja: 非線形・高次元システムの安定性・安全性を保証するライプノフ関数やバリア証明書の合成と検証の課題を解決するため、LLM駆動フレームワーク「LLM2Cert」を提案する。候補証明書を合成し、SMTソルバーまたはLeanのProof-Repairエージェントを用いて形式的に検証するパイプラインを構築した。新たに設計した高次元・制御制約付きシステムを含むベンチマーク「DynaCertBench」において、フィードバックなしの1回提案より17.1ポイント高い77.1%の検証成功率を達成し、既存手法が未解決だったケースも解決した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM活用と制御理論・軌道安定性の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: GeoDiv KAN Solver for Time Fractional Navier Stokes Equations on Complex Domains to Realistic CFD Reconstruction
papers.summary: Scientific machine learning provides a promising framework for solving complex problems in science and engineering. Notably, physics informed neural networks (PINNs) have shown considerable potential for solving differential equations and modelling engineering systems. Solving time fractional Navier Stokes equations (TFNSEs) on complex domains is challenging due to temporal nonlocality, nonlinear flow dynamics, geometric complexity, and incompressibility constraints. To address these challenges, we propose a geometry gated, divergence-free Gaussian radial basis function Kolmogorov Arnold network (GeoDiv KAN). The proposed architecture uses geometry dependent feature gating and a streamfunction formulation to preserve incompressibility by construction. GeoDiv KAN is evaluated for the time fractional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on square, circular, and star-shaped domains. Numerical experiments show that GeoDiv KAN achieves higher predictive accuracy than PINN, PIKAN, RBF KAN, and DF RBFKAN across the considered benchmark problems. To establish practical relevance, GeoDiv KAN is applied to two data driven CFD cases: unsteady flow past a circular cylinder using the \href{https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5039610}{Zenodo dataset} and turbulent RANS flow through a complex U bend using the \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/JDecke/ubend-cfd}{U-bend dataset}.
papers.title_ja: 複雑な領域における時間分数Navier-Stokes方程式の解法としてのGeoDiv KAN Solverと現実的なCFD再構築
papers.summary_ja: 複雑な幾何学領域における時間分数Navier-Stokes方程式の解法として、幾何学ゲートと発散ゼロガウスRBFを組み合わせたKolmogorov-Arnoldネットワーク（GeoDiv KAN）を提案する。このアーキテクチャはストリーム関数を用いることで非圧縮性を構造的に保証し、従来のPINNや他のKAN変種よりも高い予測精度を実現した。さらに、円柱周りの非定常流やU字弯管の乱流RANS計算といったデータ駆動型CFDケースへの適用を通じて、実務的な有効性を検証している。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルの高度な応用であり、関心領域に直結する。

papers.title: Benchmarking Model Compression Techniques Across Heterogeneous Edge Platforms: A Predictive Maintenance Use Case for Rotating Machinery
papers.summary: To enable Industry 5.0, where autonomous systems are widely adopted and integrated with people to promote sustainable development in industries, it is imperative to adapt complex deep learning models to operate efficiently on resource-constrained hardware for edge inference. However, adapting these models remains challenging due to the hardware heterogeneity of edge computing in industrial settings, performance degradation caused by model compression, and the lack of clear guidance on which compression techniques are practical and effective for applications such as predictive maintenance. To address these challenges, this paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of four state-of-the-art model compression techniques applied to a high-performance convolutional neural network for predictive maintenance using a real-world dataset of rotating machinery, equipment typically used in industry. The compressed models were evaluated across a heterogeneous set of nine computing platforms, ranging from highly constrained edge computing devices to general purpose and high-performance processors, reflecting the diversity and fragmentation typical of industrial edge environments. By jointly prioritizing classification performance, inference speed, and compression ratio, we found that compression using knowledge distillation emerged as the most effective approach. The model had more than 90% speedup across all devices while maintaining a 91.22% balanced F-score, with a very small drop in predictive performance relative to the uncompressed model, along with a 98.9% size reduction. Through successful deployment across multiple edge platforms and a systematic comparison of compression strategies, we demonstrated a clear path to achieving Industry 5.0 targets, drastically cutting computational costs and, consequently, energy consumption without sacrificing predictive performance.
papers.title_ja: 異種エッジプラットフォームにおけるモデル圧縮技術のベンチマーク：回転機械の予知保全ユースケース
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、産業用回転機械の予知保全向けCNNモデルに対し、4種のモデル圧縮技術（量子化、剪定、知識蒸留など）を適用し、9種の異種エッジデバイス上で性能を比較評価した。分類精度、推論速度、圧縮率を総合的に考慮した結果、知識蒸留が最も有効であることが示された。この手法により、全デバイスで90%以上の高速化と98.9%のサイズ削減を達成しつつ、91.22%のバランスFスコアを維持した。資源制約の厳しい産業環境における効率的なエッジ推論の実現方法として、明確な指針を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化・量子化・エッジ推論のベンチマークに直結

papers.title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
papers.summary: Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, improving resolution from 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13 times cost. Across both models, SWE-Verifier verifies fewer than 4% of steps and achieves comparable or higher resolution than the trajectory and all-step baselines at substantially lower cost. These results demonstrate that selective candidate sampling and lightweight verification provide complementary gains in coding-agent performance and inference efficiency. Our model, code, and data are available at https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier.
papers.title_ja: SWE-VERIFIER: コスト効率の良いコーディングエージェントのための選択的検証
papers.summary_ja: コーディングエージェントの計算コストとAPI費用を削減するため、軽量な生成モデルSWE-Verifierを提案する。このモデルは、エージェントのアクションをスコアリングし、必要に応じてのみ候補アクションのサンプリングと検証を行う選択的アプローチを採用する。Qwen3.5-4Bをベースに好意データで訓練し、MiniMax-M2.7およびDeepSeek-V4-Flashにおいて、コストを約1.1倍に抑えつつ解決率を向上させることを示した。全ステップ検証と比較し、4%未満のステップでのみ検証を行うことで、同等以上の性能を低コストで実現する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と推論効率化の両立に直結する手法

papers.title: Generalizing Metropolis-Hastings for DAG Sampling
papers.summary: A fundamental challenge in Bayesian network structure learning lies in efficiently approximating the posterior distribution of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). For large, high-dimensional datasets, the task remains beyond the capabilities of current methods. This work advances Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms by introducing novel moves that simultaneously resample the parents for multiple nodes of the DAG. At the core of these moves is duet sampling, a new generalization of the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm that selects two proposal distributions from a pool at each iteration. One is used for generating a candidate state of the Markov chain and another for evaluating the return to the current state; both are ingredients of an appropriately crafted acceptance criterion. Pairing different proposal distributions provides additional freedom and enables constructing Markov chains that mix more efficiently than their basic Metropolis-Hastings counterparts, at no additional computational cost. Experiments show that our new moves, both individually and in combination, outperform the previous state of the art, which relies on a more restrictive pool of moves. This advantage persists even when letting the previous methods leverage duet sampling to enhance their performance.
papers.title_ja: DAGサンプリングのためのメトロポリス・ハースティングス法の一般化
papers.summary_ja: ベイズネットワークの構造学習において、高次元データに対する有向非巡回グラフ（DAG）の事後分布推定を高速化するために、メトロポリス・ハースティングス法を拡張した「デュエットサンプリング」を提案する。この手法は、候補状態の生成と現在の状態への復帰評価に異なる提案分布をペアで用いることで、計算コストを増やさずにマルコフ連鎖の混合効率を向上させる。実験により、従来の手法よりも効率的なサンプリングが可能であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化やMCMC手法の効率化に関心があり、高度なサンプリングアルゴリズムに該当するため。

papers.title: GAV: A scientific experimentation environment for PDE agents
papers.summary: Reliable feedback is essential for coding agents to develop programs for partial differential equations (PDEs). Yet evaluating these programs on new PDE problems often requires expensive reference computations, while fixed datasets restrict the range of experiments. We introduce Generator-Agent-Verifier (GAV), a scientific experimentation environment that makes new PDE problems verifiable by construction. The Generator learns a distribution of continuous reference solutions using data from numerical simulations or experimental measurements to represent a target physical regime. Using the method of manufactured solutions, it works backward from the generated reference solutions to construct matching PDE problems without a separate numerical solve. The Agent designs experiments, investigates failures, and iteratively improves its program. The Verifier evaluates candidate programs against the reference solutions and provides numerical feedback on accuracy and computational cost. This feedback can also guide the generation of new problems that probe the current program's weaknesses. We provide a theoretical analysis of evaluation reliability and guided development. Experiments on Navier-Stokes and Vlasov-Poisson-type equations across different data sources and regimes demonstrate the effectiveness of GAV. In particular, on the numerical Navier-Stokes task, GAV reduces the mean test error of three existing PDE agents by more than an order of magnitude relative to their original setups. Code is available at https://github.com/PotatoJnny/PDE-GAV.
papers.title_ja: GAV: 偏微分方程式（PDE）エージェントのための科学的実験環境
papers.summary_ja: 偏微分方程式（PDE）を解くコーディングエージェントの信頼性評価と開発を支援する環境「GAV」を提案する。ジェネレーターが数値シミュレーションや実験データから連続的な参照解の分布を学習し、製造解法を用いて新たなPDE問題を構築することで、高コストな参照計算なしに検証可能にする。エージェントが実験設計・失敗分析・プログラム改善を反復し、ベリファイヤーが精度と計算コストのフィードバックを与える。ナビエ・ストークス方程式やヴラソフ・ポアソン方程式での実験により、既存のPDEエージェントのテスト誤差を1桁以上低減する効果を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報モデルやPDE解法へのAI適用、エージェント設計、評価手法の観点で高度に関連する。

papers.title: Spike-Aware Gradient-Based Mixed-Precision Quantization of Spiking Neural Networks for Vision Applications
papers.summary: In recent years, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have gained massive attention as an energy-efficient neural computing paradigm due to their event-driven and sparse computing capability. However, maintaining accuracy under low-precision constraints, necessary for practical deployment, has been largely unexplored for SNN models. In addition, existing Hessian-based approaches for quantization, such as HAWQ-V2, incur significant memory and computational overhead due to temporal unrolling across multiple SNN timesteps. We propose a spike-aware gradient-based mixed-precision quantization framework for SNNs that adaptively assigns bit-widths using first-order gradient information, avoiding costly second-order Hessian computations. We evaluate our method across various SNN-based architectures, including VGG, ResNet, and Vision Transformer models obtained from both ANN-to-SNN conversion and direct training frameworks, on CIFAR10/100, ImageNet, and DVS-CIFAR-10 datasets. Notably, on ResNet-34 evaluated on ImageNet, our method achieves 73.30% accuracy at 4.78$\times$ compression, which is comparable to that provided by HAWQ-V2, while reducing memory consumption by 2.31$\times$ and bit-allocation runtime by 100$\times$. We also present an energy analysis for mixed-precision SNNs showing that the proposed quantization strategy enables energy-efficient deployment without compromising performance.
papers.title_ja: 視覚応用向けスパイキングニューラルネットワークのスパイク認識型勾配ベース混合精度量子化
papers.summary_ja: スパイキングニューラルネットワーク（SNN）における低精度量子化の課題に対し、スパイク特性を考慮した勾配ベースの混合精度量子化フレームワークを提案する。既存のヘッシアン行列ベース手法が持つ計算・メモリコストの高さを回避するため、一次勾配情報を用いてビット幅を適応的に割り当てる手法を採用した。ImageNet上のResNet-34において、既存手法と同等の精度を維持しつつ、メモリ消費量を2.31倍、ビット割り当ての計算時間を100倍削減する成果を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化と量子化の手法がSNNに適用され、計算効率化の観点で高関連

papers.title: Bayesian Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with Abstention
papers.summary: We study the Bayesian fixed-confidence best-arm identification problem in which a learner can abstain from making a terminal recommendation. Subject to a target error probability $\delta$ and an abstention budget $\alpha$, we propose Screen-and-Confirm (S&C) and analyze its expected stopping time. We further derive the minimum expected stopping time for any algorithm that satisfies these constraints. For Gaussian priors and rewards, as $(\delta,\alpha)\downarrow(0,0)$, we establish matching upper and lower bounds up to multiplicative constants, with rate $\kappa_\nu^2[1+\log((\alpha+\delta)/\delta)]/(\alpha+\delta)$, where $\kappa_\nu$ is the prior density of the top-two gap at zero, highlighting that nearly tied instances govern the sampling cost. When abstention is disallowed ($\alpha=0$), S&C yields the optimal $\Theta(1/\delta)$ dependence for fixed model parameters, removing the additional $\log(1/\delta)$ factor in the upper bound of Jang et al. (2024) under our Gaussian assumptions. We further characterize the exact multiplicative constant of the minimum expected stopping time for practical regimes including (i) fixed $\alpha \in (0,1)$ and (ii) $\alpha/\delta\to\infty$, which are also achieved by S&C.
papers.title_ja: 棄権を伴うベイズ固定信頼度最良アーム識別
papers.summary_ja: ベイズ固定信頼度最良アーム識別問題において、最終的な推奨を棄権（Abstention）できる設定を提案する。棄権予算と誤差確率の制約下で、Screen-and-Confirm (S&C) アルゴリズムを設計し、期待停止時間の理論的上界と下界を導出した。ガウス先験分布と報酬において、S&C は既存手法より対数項を除去した最適な $\Theta(1/\delta)$ 依存性を達成する。また、棄権が許される実用的な領域における最小期待停止時間の正確な乗数定数も特徴付け、S&C がその最適性を満たすことを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化・強化学習の基礎手法であり、評価手法の効率化に関わる

papers.title: Deep-Learning Identification and Global Characterization of Energetic O2+ Beams at Mars
papers.summary: Martian ionospheric ions can be accelerated away from Mars by the solar wind, contributing substantially to atmospheric ion escape. Here, we develop a U-Net-based image segmentation model to identify a distinct population of escaping planetary ions, energetic O2+ beams, from a decade of Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN (MAVEN) observations and perform an event-based statistical analysis of their global properties and dependence on external conditions. We find that O2+ beams are widely distributed throughout the Martian plasma environment, with a strong preference for the +E hemisphere, where the solar wind convective electric field points away from Mars. This pronounced spatial asymmetry indicates that the convective electric field plays a major role in beam formation. In the solar wind and magnetosheath, these beams are consistent with the plume. Their occurrence-weighted flux agrees with previous long-term plume estimates, whereas the flux during identified beam intervals is substantially higher. This highlights the advantage of our event-based approach in capturing the intrinsic properties of O2+ plumes. In the induced magnetotail, beam formation remains strongly associated with the convective electric field, while the Hall electric field can provide additional energization. The beam properties are primarily controlled by upstream solar wind conditions, with no apparent influence from solar extreme ultraviolet irradiance. These results might improve our understanding of ion escape at Mars. More broadly, we also demonstrate the potential of deep learning for identifying transient plasma populations from spacecraft observations.
papers.title_ja: 火星における高エネルギーO2+ビームの深層学習による識別と全球的な特性評価
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、U-Netベースの画像セグメンテーションモデルを用い、MAVEN観測データから火星大気からのイオン脱出を示す高エネルギーO2+ビームを自動識別する手法を提案する。太陽風対流電場が火星から離れる方向を向く半球でビーム発生が顕著であることを示し、空間的アシンメトリーと外部条件への依存性を統計的に分析した。イベントベースのアプローチにより、従来の長期平均値よりも高いフラックスを捉え、プラズマ環境の固有特性をより正確に評価できることを実証している。深層学習を用いた宇宙プラズマ現象の瞬時集団識別の可能性を示す研究である。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の応用だが、対象が宇宙物理であり軌道力学やLLM効率化とは遠い

papers.title: AstroBench: Benchmarking Free-Floating Capture and Space Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: Capturing a loose object inside a spacecraft requires a robot to approach a target that can translate and rotate, and whose motion changes when contact is made. These conditions motivate evaluation beyond manipulation of supported objects. We introduce AstroBench, an open benchmark for free-floating capture and space robotic manipulation with a fixed-base arm. The task suite combines four initial-motion tracks with sample-storage operations based on MELFI hardware and cap and captive-screw servicing based on the Robotic Refueling Mission. The two workcells provide nine task definitions and 29 task-target combinations. A metadata-filtered Objaverse inventory supplies 8,414 object instances for asset expansion, alongside five cabin visual contexts and versioned task instructions. We report two acquisition-focused experiments using existing checkpoints. A frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ DROID joint-position policy captures 2 of 200 static targets and 4 of 200 moving targets across twenty object identities. A cube-specific ACT policy captures 8 of 10 static targets and 6 of 10 moving targets in a separate experiment. Each experiment retains its recorded observation, action and capture configuration. The results document difficult direct transfer for the tested generalist checkpoint and successful task-specific capture behavior, while identifying concrete settings for studying motion-aware perception and contact-sensitive control. Code, task definitions and editable workcell assets are available at https://github.com/AstroUpLab/AstroBench.
papers.title_ja: AstroBench: 自由浮遊物体の捕獲と宇宙ロボティクス操作のベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: 宇宙船内で自由浮遊する物体を固定ベースアームで捕獲するタスクのためのオープンベンチマーク「AstroBench」を提案する。MELFIやRobotic Refueling Missionに基づく9つのタスク定義と、Objaverseから選定した8,414個の物体インスタンスを含む環境を提供する。既存の汎用ポリシー（π0.5 DROID）とタスク特化ポリシー（ACT）を用いた実験では、汎用モデルの直接転移の困難さと、特化モデルによる静的・動的ターゲット捕獲の成功を定量的に示した。接触感度制御や運動認識の課題を特定し、コードとアセットを公開している。
papers.relevance_reason: 宇宙ロボティクスと評価ベンチマークに関わるが、軌道力学やLLM効率化とは直接無関係

papers.title: When Reconstruction Is Not Enough: Doubly Robust Counterfactual and Interventional Mediation Analysis with Learned Multimodal Representations
papers.summary: Learned representations of high-dimensional multimodal health records are increasingly used to adjust for confounding, yet they are usually trained to reconstruct the data rather than preserve the information that causal identification requires. We study counterfactual outcomes under alternative treatments, including phenotype-specific effects and patient-level counterfactual risk profiles of the kind digital twins provide, and interventional direct and indirect effects under exposure-induced intermediate confounding. We give conditions under which a representation preserves identification and show that interventional mediation is more demanding than counterfactual comparison. We prove that no covariate-only training objective, whether reconstruction, contrastive, or physics-informed, can certify that a representation is sufficient, and that, in a linear structural model, a representation can lose arbitrarily little reconstruction accuracy yet induce arbitrarily large bias. We decompose the error of cross-fitted doubly robust estimators into a first-order representation bias, which neither double robustness nor cross-fitting removes, and a second-order remainder of nuisance-estimation errors, so coverage worsens as the sample size grows when the representation is insufficient. We propose a workflow combining modality-specific variational autoencoders trained outside the estimation sample, cross-fitted doubly robust estimators, locked phenotypes, select-then-confirm pathway analysis, portable representations, and diagnostics for representation insufficiency, exposure leakage, and sensitivity. In simulations, discarding a rare, moderately strong confounder gave indirect-effect intervals with 2% coverage at n = 3,000; reconstruction loss missed the problem, and a simple predictive diagnostic flagged it in every replicate.
papers.title_ja: 再構成だけでは不十分：学習されたマルチモーダル表現を用いた二重頑健な反事実的・介入的媒介分析
papers.summary_ja: 高次元マルチモーダルデータにおける因果推論において、再構成目的で学習された表現が識別可能性を損なう問題を指摘する。再構成誤差が小さくても因果バイアスが任意に大きくなることを理論的に証明し、二重頑健推定量の誤差構造を分解した。表現の不足を検出する診断手法と、変分オートエンコーダとクロスフィッティングを組み合わせたワークフローを提案する。シミュレーションでは、再構成損失では検出できない問題に対し、予測的診断が有効であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 因果推論と表現学習の手法は関連するが、宇宙・軌道力学の文脈ではないため中程度。

papers.title: Visualizing and Interpreting Temporal Care Team Dynamics for Cancer Survival Risk Analysis
papers.summary: Cancer care is a longitudinal, time-sensitive process requiring coordination among diverse healthcare professionals (HCPs), whose collaboration evolves throughout treatment. Prior studies link care team structure to patient outcomes, but the temporal dynamics of collaboration and their relationship to evolving patient risk remain poorly understood. We introduce a visual analytics framework for modeling and interpreting time-varying care team interactions in oncology. We construct dynamic collaboration networks from electronic health record (EHR)-mediated communication data and use a temporal graph neural network (TGNN) to estimate patient outcome risk over time. We then investigate how changes in care team composition and specialist participation relate to shifts in estimated risk across treatment stages. Our multi-view interactive system combines TGNN-based risk modeling with coordinated visualizations of care team networks, feature-level explanations from a surrogate logistic regression model, and exploratory what-if analysis. Without making causal claims, the system helps analysts examine how risk estimates co-evolve with collaboration patterns and identify care team characteristics associated with these changes. We demonstrate its utility through expert-guided analysis scenarios involving 505 patients with breast, colorectal, and lung cancers, evaluating its ability to reveal clinically meaningful collaboration patterns. This work improves the interpretability of temporal graph-based models in longitudinal, team-based healthcare, with potential applicability to other evolving collaborative settings.
papers.title_ja: がん生存リスク分析における時間的ケアチーム動態の可視化と解釈
papers.summary_ja: がん治療における医療チームの時間的協調動態をモデル化し、患者リスクとの関連を解釈するためのビジュアルアナリティクスフレームワークを提案する。電子カルテ（EHR）データから動的協調ネットワークを構築し、時間グラフニューラルネットワーク（TGNN）を用いて時間変化する患者リスクを推定する。TGNNの出力を補完するため、サロゲートモデルとしてロジスティック回帰を用いた特徴量レベルの説明可能性分析と、インタラクティブなWhat-if分析機能を統合した。505例のがん患者データを用いたケーススタディにより、治療段階におけるチーム構成の変化とリスク推定値の変動の関連性を臨床的に意味のある形で可視化・解釈できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: TGNNとサロゲートモデルの活用は関心領域だが、医療特化のため

papers.title: OP-Print: Tracing Membership Imprints in On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.summary: On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation. Self-distillation further removes the need for an external teacher by using the student's own outputs, enhanced with extra context or demonstrations, as supervision. This teacher-free design makes on-policy self-distillation practical, yet its privacy risks remain largely unexplored. In particular, using two coupled views of the same training example may strengthen its memorization. Motivated by this, we present the first study of membership inference attacks against on-policy self-distillation. We investigate both gray-box and black-box threat models and propose a unified attack framework, named OP-Print. OP-Print builds on our finding that the supervision imprint in on-policy self-distillation is sparse and structured, concentrating on uncertainty-sensitive correction sites rather than across the entire rollout. Exploiting this property, we construct attack signals tailored to the two access levels: in the gray-box setting, OP-Print directly aggregates the privileged teacher-student residual correction along the same rollout; in the black-box setting, it measures restart-based output-basin stability as an observable surrogate for the hidden correction process. Across diverse models and distillation schemes, all baseline attacks remain essentially at random guessing even under gray-box access, whereas OP-Print is broadly validated to be effective in both gray-box and black-box settings.
papers.title_ja: OP-Print: オンポリシー自己蒸留におけるメンバーシップ痕跡の追跡
papers.summary_ja: オンポリシー自己蒸留のプライバシーリスクを初めて調査し、メンバーシップ推論攻撃フレームワーク「OP-Print」を提案する。教師モデル不要な自己蒸留では、同一訓練データの2つの結合ビューが記憶を強化し、不確実性に敏感な修正箇所にスパースかつ構造化された監督痕跡が残ることを発見した。この特性を利用し、グレーボックスでは教師-生徒の残差補正を、ブラックボックスでは出力盆地の安定性を代理指標として用いる攻撃手法を構築した。多様なモデルで検証され、ベースラインがランダム推測レベルにとどまる中、OP-Printは両アクセスレベルで有効性を示した。

papers.title: SciFusion: Physics-Guided Compositional Diffusion for Multimodal 3D Scientific Image Generation
papers.summary: Existing 3D generative approaches are typically developed for individual imaging modalities, requiring substantial modality-specific data and limiting their ability to exploit shared structure across scientific imaging domains. We present SciFusion, a multimodal framework for unified 3D scientific image generation built on a latent diffusion backbone, with two key contributions. First, we introduce a compositional conditioning scheme that factorizes each modality into domain, object, and contrast representations. Sharing these factors across related modalities enables knowledge transfer across heterogeneous imaging domains and allows the factors to be recombined at inference time to synthesize unseen domain-object-contrast compositions in a zero-shot manner. Second, we incorporate domain-specific physics-informed objectives: Fourier spectral consistency for MRI, Radon projection consistency for CT, and multislice diffraction consistency for electron microscopy, to encourage generated samples to respect modality-dependent image formation processes. Extensive experiments across 15 medical and scientific imaging modalities demonstrate that SciFusion improves generation fidelity and cross-domain generalization over modality-specific and flattened multimodal conditioning strategies, while enabling zero-shot synthesis of unseen compositions without training on those target compositions. These results demonstrate that compositional, physics-guided conditioning provides a scalable framework for unified 3D scientific image generation, particularly for emerging modalities where large-scale training data are difficult to obtain.
papers.title_ja: SciFusion: 物理情報に基づく組み合わせ拡散モデルによるマルチモーダル3D科学画像生成
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、MRIやCTなど異なる科学画像モダリティを統合的に生成するマルチモーダルフレームワーク「SciFusion」を提案する。潜在拡散モデルを基盤とし、ドメイン・オブジェクト・コントラストを要素分解する組み合わせ条件付けにより、未見の組み合わせをゼロショットで合成可能にする。さらに、フーリエスペクトル整合性やラドン射影整合性など、各モダリティ固有の物理法則を損失関数に組み込むことで、物理的に妥当な画像生成を実現した。15種類の医療・科学画像での実験により、既存手法を上回る生成精度とクロスドメイン汎化性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットの応用だが、対象が科学画像生成であり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Vision Transformers for Estimating Irradiance Using Data Scarce Sky Images
papers.summary: Accurate estimation of diffuse horizontal irradiance (DHI) is critical for optimising photovoltaic system performance and energy forecasting yet remains challenging in regions lacking comprehensive ground-based instrumentation. Recent advancements using Vision Transformers (ViTs) trained on extensive sky image datasets have shown promise in replacing costly irradiance measurement equipment, but the scarcity of long-term, high-quality sky imagery significantly restricts practical implementation. Addressing this critical gap, this study proposes a novel dual-framework approach designed for data-scarce scenarios. First, calculated atmospheric parameters, including extraterrestrial irradiance and cyclic time encodings, are integrated to represent sky conditions without utilising any instrumentation. Next, a sequential pipeline initially predicts synthetic global horizontal irradiance (GHI) and uses it as a feature, to refine DHI estimation. Finally, a dual-parallel architecture simultaneously processes raw and overlay-enhanced fisheye sky images. Overlays are generated through unsupervised, physics-informed cloud segmentation to highlight dynamic sky features. Empirical validation is performed using data from the Chilbolton Observatory, chosen for its temperate climate and frequent cloud variability. To simulate data-scarce conditions, models are trained on a single month (e.g., January) and evaluated across a temporally disjoint, full-year test set. Under this setup, the sequential and dual-parallel frameworks achieve RMSE values within 2-3 W/m^2 and 1-6 W/m^2, respectively, of a state-of-the-art ViT trained on the complete dataset. By combining physics-informed modelling with unsupervised segmentation, the proposed method provides a scalable and cost-effective solution for DHI estimation, advancing solar resource assessment in data-constrained environments.
papers.title_ja: データ希少な空画像を用いた放射量推定のためのビジョントランスフォーマー
papers.summary_ja: 太陽光発電の性能最適化に必要な水平面散乱放射量（DHI）の推定において、高品質な空画像データが不足する環境への対応を目的とした研究である。物理情報に基づく無教師学習セグメンテーションにより空の特徴を強調し、合成放射量予測と生画像処理を並列・逐次処理するデュアルフレームワークを提案した。データ希少条件下（1ヶ月分の学習）でも、フルデータセットで訓練した最先端モデルに近い精度（RMSE 1-6 W/m^2）を達成した。物理法則と深層学習を組み合わせることで、コスト効率の良い太陽資源評価手法を実現している。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報と深層学習の組み合わせは関心領域だが、応用分野が太陽光であり軌道力学とは異なるため中程度。

papers.title: Retraction-Free Nonsmooth Optimization on the Stiefel Manifold: Subgradient and Proximal Landing Methods
papers.summary: We develop three retraction-free Landing methods for nonsmooth composite optimization over the Stiefel manifold, combining an (approximately) tangential direction with an infeasibility-reducing normal direction. The subgradient Landing method, with normal stepsizes parameterized by $\alpha\in[0,1]$, has best-iterate complexity bounds $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-4})$ for surrogate stationarity and $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2/(2-\alpha)})$ for feasibility. For $\alpha=0$, it converges locally $R$-linearly under local weak sharpness and mild assumptions. The proximal gradient Landing method computes a tangential direction by solving a proximal subproblem and combines it with the same normal direction. Moreover, the inexact proximal gradient Landing method allows the proximal subproblem to be solved approximately and applies an explicit correction to control violations of the tangency condition. Both proximal methods have outer-iteration complexity bounds $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ for stationarity and $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-1})$ for feasibility, and every accumulation point is first-order stationary. Under an additional asymptotic Bregman-error condition and the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz property of a suitable auxiliary function, the primal sequence of the inexact method converges to a first-order stationary point. Numerical experiments illustrate the effectiveness of all three methods. On the tested sparse principal component analysis instances, the inexact method has favorable running times, and both proximal methods maintain small feasibility residuals.
papers.title_ja: Stiefel多様体におけるRetraction-Freeな非滑らか最適化：Subgradient法とProximal Landing法
papers.summary_ja: Stiefel多様体上の非滑らか複合最適化問題に対し、Retractionを必要としない3つのLanding手法を提案する。Subgradient法は局所弱鋭性条件下でR線形収束を示し、Proximal法は近接サブ問題を解くことで定常点への収束を保証する。不正確なProximal法は計算効率を向上させ、数値実験ではスパース主成分分析において優れた実行時間と可行性残差の低減を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習の最適化手法全般に関わるが、軌道力学やLLM特化ではないため中程度

papers.title: Model Predictive Control of Wind Turbines: A Model-Oriented Review of Prediction Models, Control Objectives, and Nonlinear Aerodynamic Formulations
papers.summary: Model predictive control (MPC) has been applied to wind-turbine regulation with markedly different internal prediction models, ranging from linearized low-order turbine models to nonlinear, aeroelastic, floating, and data-driven predictors. This review organizes the literature primarily by the model propagated by the controller and treats model order, predictor representation, MPC formulation, control objective, and validation plant as separate descriptors. Primary studies show that low-order linear or piecewise-affine predictors are attractive for constrained power and speed regulation, whereas flexible drivetrain, structural, and floating models are needed when drivetrain twist, tower motion, blade loads, or platform dynamics are explicit control quantities. Nonlinear and economic MPC studies further demonstrate coordinated pitch/torque control across broad operating regions, while preview, repetitive, and data-driven formulations address wind prediction, periodic loads, and model mismatch. Particular attention is given to aerodynamic pitch dependence: variable-pitch turbine dynamics can be non-affine with respect to applied pitch, and the term NMPC alone does not prove that the original nonlinear pitch map is retained inside the optimizer. The review therefore adopts a conservative, equation-based classification for direct nonlinear applied-pitch propagation. Here, direct nonlinear applied-pitch propagation means that the applied pitch at each prediction step is evaluated inside the original nonlinear aerodynamic map, rather than replacing that dependence by a linearized, scheduled, piecewise-affine, or learned surrogate. The literature supports a remaining integration challenge at the intersection of flexible drivetrain prediction, nonlinear aerodynamic pitch treatment, explicit constraints and load objectives, and validated adaptive or learned model correction.
papers.title_ja: 風力タービンのモデル予測制御：予測モデル、制御目標、非線形気動力学定式化に関するモデル指向レビュー
papers.summary_ja: 風力タービンのモデル予測制御（MPC）において、線形低次モデルから非線形・データ駆動型予測モデルまでの多様な内部モデルを整理したレビュー論文である。制御対象の自由度や目的に応じて、低次線形モデルが制約付き出力制御に、柔軟な駆動系・構造モデルが負荷・振動制御に適していることを示す。特に、ピッチ角に対する非線形気動力学特性を最適化器内で直接扱う「直接非線形適用ピッチ伝播」の重要性を強調し、線形化やサロゲートモデルによる近似との違いを明確にしている。最後に、柔軟な駆動系予測、非線形気動力学、明示的制約、適応型モデル補正の統合が今後の課題であると結論づけている。

papers.title: How Prompt Style Affects AI Accuracy and Speed in Competitive Programming
papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly used in competitive programming, and their outputs are sensitive to how a prompt is phrased. Prior work has compared prompt strategies for accuracy on competitive programming, but not for runtime speed, and has not situated the results against human performance. In an exploratory study of one prompt in each of nine styles on GPT-5.5 across three accuracy tasks from the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) and two NP-hard speed tasks, we found that no single prompt was best: the strongest prompt depended on the task type and on whether results were summarized by the mean or the median, suggesting that, at least for these tasks, prompt style should be matched to the objective rather than treated as universal. Many differences in mean scores came from a few outlier runs, showing that evaluating prompting by a single metric can obscure how much its effectiveness varies. Compared descriptively with human IOI contestants, who worked under different conditions, the AI was neither strictly better nor strictly worse, exceeding the average contestant on one task but falling short on the other two. By extending prompt comparison from accuracy to runtime speed and grounding it against human performance, this study gives a broader picture of how prompt style affects competitive programming performance.
papers.title_ja: プロンプトスタイルが競プロにおけるAIの精度と速度に与える影響
papers.summary_ja: 競プロにおけるLLMの出力がプロンプトの表現に敏感であることを示す研究で、GPT-5.5を用いて9種類のプロンプトスタイルをIOIタスクで評価した。精度だけでなく実行速度も比較し、単一の最適プロンプトが存在せず、タスク種別や評価指標（平均・中央値）によって最適なスタイルが異なることを明らかにした。また、人間のIOI参加者との比較を通じて、AIが常に優位であるわけではないことを示し、プロンプト設計が目的に応じて調整されるべきであるという知見を得た。

papers.title: Edit, Don't Imitate: Minimal-Edit On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.summary: Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. Across model scales, the method requires no descriptions at test time and meets or exceeds the corresponding base model supplied with a reference figure description at inference. It also improves perception-oriented performance, particularly low-level geometric perception, and transfers to external mathematics and perception benchmarks. Because the minimal-edit teacher evaluates corrections rather than generating its own solution, the method remains effective with a frozen same-size teacher, although its gains are smaller than with a larger teacher on most metrics.
papers.title_ja: 模倣ではなく編集：マルチモーダル推論のための最小編集オンポリシー蒸留
papers.summary_ja: 視覚言語モデル（VLM）における図解の誤読という知覚的ボトルネックを解決するため、最小編集オンポリシー蒸留手法を提案する。教師モデルが誤った推論経路に対して最小限の修正のみをスコアリングし、誤ったトークンにのみ損失を課すことで、完全な回答模倣を避けつつオンポリシーな学習を実現する。テスト時には追加の記述やモデル呼び出しを必要とせず、推論時の性能が参照図解記述付きのベースモデル以上になることを示した。また、低レベル幾何学的知覚の向上や外部ベンチマークへの転移効果も確認されている。

papers.title: Rethinking SAE Evaluation: An Atomic Interpretable Unit Framework Reveals Hidden Polysemanticity and Redundancy
papers.summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) were originally motivated by discovering monosemantic features, a property that characterizes individual features but does not specify what the learned feature set should look like as a whole. As SAEs have increasingly been adopted for attribution, circuit discovery, and intervention, researchers have begun evaluating metrics that describe global properties of the feature set, such as sparsity, dead feature rates, reconstruction fidelity, and disentanglement, a diverse set that extends far beyond monosemanticity. However, this implicit shift beyond monosemanticity has not been formalized as a clear, well-defined objective that comes before these evaluation metrics. Without such an objective, existing metrics remain ad hoc, with their necessity unjustified. In this work, we formalize this ultimate objective by introducing a new paradigm for SAE evaluation: requiring that SAE features, and more generally dictionary-based decompositions of model representations, form an atomic interpretable unit basis, a coordinate system for semantically meaningful explanation. Under this paradigm, we organize existing and new measurements such as DAME (Dominance-Aware Monosemanticity Evaluation) as proxy metrics and introduce a comprehensive benchmarking framework. Evaluating hundreds of SAEs across multiple architectures and model families, we uncover failure modes in which some SAEs appear monosemantic under existing evaluation metrics while remaining functionally polysemantic: the most dominant features, those contributing most to model computation, are systematically less interpretable and more redundant. These failure modes warrant attention from SAE researchers as targets for improved training and architectures, and motivate dominance-aware evaluation as a standard check for practitioners before SAE features are deployed for attribution, circuit tracing, or intervention.
papers.title_ja: SAE評価の再考：アトミック解釈可能ユニットフレームワークによる隠れた多義性と冗長性の解明
papers.summary_ja: スパースオートエンコーダ（SAE）の評価指標が単一意味性を超えたグローバル特性にシフトしている現状に対し、本研究は「アトミック解釈可能ユニット基底」という明確な目標を形式化し、既存指標を代理指標として整理する。この枠組みを用いて数百のSAEを評価した結果、既存指標では単一意味的と見なされるものの、計算への寄与が大きい主要な特徴量が解釈可能性が低く冗長であるという失敗モードを発見した。この発見は、帰属分析や回路追跡への実務適用前に、支配度考慮型評価を行う必要性を強調している。

papers.title: Motion Retargeting with Spatiotemporal Preferences for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary: Human motion retargeting bridges the embodiment gap between humans and humanoid robots by converting human demonstrations into reference trajectories for whole-body control and loco-manipulation. For object-interaction tasks, successful execution depends on accurately preserving body--object relations at critical stages. However, uniform per-frame iteration budgets do not account for these localized accuracy requirements, limiting the computational efficiency of retargeting. To address this limitation, we present Spatiotemporal Retargeting (STR), which uses keyframes and key body parts to allocate optimization effort. Specifically, a vision-language model selects relevant motion signals and body parts, and keyframes are identified from changes in the selected signals. Based on these selections, STR assigns additional solver iterations to keyframes and higher interaction weights to the selected parts. To further improve contact fidelity, we introduce Mechanics-Aware Contact Anchoring (MCA) to refine object-surface contact positions using an approximate object-wrench model while retaining the selected surface directions. Building on the resulting references, we develop Spatiotemporal Reinforcement Learning (STRL), which combines adaptive key-stage sampling with a contact reward based on target proximity and object contact forces for downstream control. Simulation experiments on a Unitree G1 and real-world experiments on a Unitree R1 demonstrate that STR improves geometric contact coverage and continuity at lower computational cost, while the resulting references improve downstream task completion across diverse object-interaction motions.
papers.title_ja: ヒューマノイドのロコモニピュレーションにおける時空間的嗜好に基づくモーションリターゲティング
papers.summary_ja: ヒューマノイドロボットへの人間動作の転用（リターゲティング）において、キーフレームと重要な身体部位に最適化計算を集中させることで効率性を高める手法を提案する。ビジョン言語モデルを用いて関連する運動シグナルと部位を選択し、それらに追加のソルバ反復回数を割り当てることで、接触精度を維持しつつ計算コストを削減する。さらに、力学を考慮した接触アンカリングにより物体との接触位置を精緻化し、強化学習による制御と組み合わせることで、シミュレーションおよび実機でのタスク遂行率向上を実証した。

papers.title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
papers.summary: Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices. We examine two ways to handle aging signals: retain them and give a portfolio policy timing information, or filter them out before portfolio selection. A fixed large language model (LLM) extracts signals from public SEC disclosures. We compare these treatments in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and LLMs that choose portfolios directly. We evaluate returns after trading costs in historical tests over 2023-2025. RL choices respond to timing information in a controlled test, but historical returns show no consistent benefit from adding it. For the LLM, filtering old news produced the highest average net return, reaching 18.43% per year when news delivery was delayed by four weeks. This exceeded the returns of all RL strategies that used news.
papers.title_ja: ニュースが古くなったとき：強化学習と大規模言語モデルを用いたポートフォリオ配分
papers.summary_ja: 金融ニュースの時間的鮮度（エイジング）が投資判断に与える影響を、強化学習（RL）と大規模言語モデル（LLM）を用いて分析する。SEC開示情報からLLMでシグナルを抽出し、古いニュースをフィルタリングするか、タイミング情報を付与したままRLポリシーに渡すかの2つの手法を比較した。2023-2025年の履歴データでの評価において、RLはタイミング情報に反応するものの一貫した利益向上は見られなかった。一方、LLMによる直接のポートフォリオ選択において、古いニュースをフィルタリングした手法が最も高い平均純収益（年率18.43%）を達成した。

papers.title: Future of Time Series Anomaly Detection: From Historical Review to Unified Outlook
papers.summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is a foundational problem in data mining, aiming to identify observations that deviate significantly from nominal temporal patterns. Driven by escalating data volumes and application complexity, recent research has yielded diverse architectures, including diffusion models, state space models, and large language models (LLMs). However, existing surveys provide limited coverage of these emerging designs and lack a unified treatment of multivariate anomalies, cross-domain unified modeling, metric reliability, and contemporary evaluation challenges. To bridge these gaps, this survey delivers three core contributions: (1) We establish a refined anomaly categorization and a structured taxonomy of paradigms reflecting modern advances, comparing detection mechanisms and charting developmental trajectories across paradigms. (2) We provide an extensive analysis of evaluation methodologies and conduct comprehensive experiments to assess metric fidelity, complemented by an open-source benchmark repository encompassing algorithms, datasets, and evaluation tools. (3) We outline key open challenges, offering forward-looking perspectives on dynamic thresholding, model interpretability, zero-shot transfer, multi-modal alignment, and foundational models for time series. By addressing existing theoretical and empirical limitations, this survey establishes a coherent framework to guide future TSAD research and practical deployments.
papers.title_ja: 時系列異常検知の未来：歴史的レビューから統合的な展望へ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、拡散モデルや状態空間モデル、LLMなど最新の時系列異常検知（TSAD）手法を網羅したサーベイである。既存のレビューがカバーしきれていない多変量異常やクロスドメインモデリング、評価指標の信頼性に関する課題を整理し、精緻な分類体系を構築した。さらに、指標の忠実度を検証する包括的な実験と、アルゴリズム・データセット・評価ツールを含むオープンソースベンチマークリポジトリを提供する。最後に、動的閾値設定やゼロショット転移、時系列基盤モデルなど、今後の研究課題と実務展開に向けた展望を提示している。

papers.title: Neural Networks with Differentiable Belief-Function Layers
papers.summary: Yager's 1987 rule of combination $\boxplus$ was proposed on epistemic grounds: under high conflict, mass should be redistributed to ignorance rather than renormalised onto the class simplex. We observe that backpropagation needs the same rule: Dempster's normaliser $(1{-}\kappa)^{-1}$, where $\kappa$ is the conflict mass, puts a $(1{-}\kappa)^{-2}$ term in the gradient that diverges exactly when evidence sources disagree, while Yager's $\boxplus$ is bilinear and has no such term. Building on this, we construct a deep evidential pipeline in which every mass in the chain from heads to output is a valid Dempster--Shafer mass function, combined by Yager's rule. The output mass on the ignorance set, $m(\Theta)$, serves as the network's ``I do not know'' signal. The network is fit to hard labels and never sees an annotator distribution, yet $m(\Theta)$ orders human disagreement in two modalities, visual and linguistic. Dempster's rises too and ranks contested inputs about as well, but its normaliser divides the conflict out: Yager's vacuity is $9\times$ larger on the most contested CIFAR-10H images, so only Yager's is readable as an amount of ignorance without recalibration. For out-of-distribution detection it is competitive with strong single-pass baselines, while the clamped Dempster variant that scores higher becomes gradient-unstable once the clamp is removed.
papers.title_ja: 微分可能な信念関数層を持つニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: Dempster-Shafer理論におけるYagerの結合則を用いた、微分可能な信念関数層を備えた深層学習パイプラインを提案する。Dempsterの正規化項が勾配発散を引き起こす問題に対し、Yager則は双線形であり勾配が安定することを示した。出力の無知集合への質量を「知らない」シグナルとして活用し、人間の不確実性を順序付けられることを視覚・言語データで検証した。分布外検出においても強力なベースラインと競争力を持ち、勾配不安定性を回避しつつ解釈可能な不確実性を提供できる。

papers.title: SIGNN++: Robust Graph Neural Star Identification on Earth
papers.summary: We present SIGNN++, a learning-based star identification (SID) framework for celestial navigation in GNSS-denied nighttime environments. Although researchers have developed learning-based SID methods to improve robustness to observation noise, prior evaluations have focused mainly on synthetic or non-terrestrial environments, leaving their reliability under real terrestrial conditions unclear. To address these limitations, SIGNN++ extends SIGNN, a graph neural network-based SID method, with three components: a more realistic noise model for training data, Fourier Transform (FT) of angular-distance edge features, and RANSAC-based Perspective Star Alignment for identification and attitude refinement. The results show that SIGNN++ is more robust to terrestrial observation disturbances and achieves higher star identification accuracy and solved rates than the original SIGNN and publicly available SID baselines, while maintaining comparable attitude accuracy and practical computation time for continuous operation. The implementation code of SIGNN++ and datasets will be available at https://signnpp.github.io/signnpp/.
papers.title_ja: SIGNN++: 地上における頑健なグラフニューラルネットワークによる星体識別
papers.summary_ja: GNSS利用不能な夜間の宇宙航行向けに、グラフニューラルネットワーク（GNN）を用いた星体識別フレームワークSIGNN++を提案する。従来の学習ベース手法が合成データや非地上環境での評価に偏っていた問題を解決するため、より現実的なノイズモデル、角度距離エッジ特徴量のフーリエ変換、およびRANSACベースの姿勢補正アルゴリズムを導入した。その結果、地上での観測擾乱に対する頑健性が向上し、既存手法やベースラインと比較して星体識別の精度と成功率を向上させつつ、実用的な計算時間を維持している。

papers.title: Spectral Uncertainty Decomposition for Sparse Bayesian Learning
papers.summary: Estimating distributed neural sources from M/EEG measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem where principled uncertainty quantification remains challenging. The usual conditional Gaussian posterior covariance does not explicitly distinguish uncertainty along likelihood-visible source directions from uncertainty that is invisible to the measurements. We propose a spectral framework based on the singular value structure of the prior-preconditioned forward operator, which provides an exact, interpretable decomposition of the posterior covariance into data-informed and indeterminacy epistemic components. This formulation identifies uncertainty contributions that are reducible by better measurements from those that are fundamentally irreducible by sensing geometry. We further derive an equivalent subtractive decomposition that expresses the prior covariance as the sum of posterior and data-driven reduction terms, enabling precise accounting of uncertainty reduction through Bayesian learning. Together, these complementary representations offer both theoretical insight and practical tools for interpretable uncertainty quantification in M/EEG source imaging for linear-Gaussian Bayesian inverse solvers where the posterior covariance is available in closed form.
papers.title_ja: スパースベイズ学習におけるスペクトル不確実性分解
papers.summary_ja: M/EEG測定からの神経源推定という逆問題を対象に、後方分散をデータ由来の不確実性と測定幾何学による不確定性成分に厳密に分解するスペクトルフレームワークを提案する。事前条件付けされた前進演算子の特異値構造に基づき、測定改善で低減可能な不確実性と本質的に不変な不確実性を区別する。さらに、ベイズ学習による不確実性低減を定量的に記述する減算型分解式も導出する。線形ガウスモデルにおいて後方分散が閉形式で得られる場合に適用可能であり、解釈可能な不確実性定量化の実用的なツールを提供する。

papers.title: TerraTransfer++: Demonstration-Free End-to-End Planner
papers.summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks and real-world deployments. Its standard training recipe, however, is expensive across all existing paradigms: imitation learning requires fleet-scale driving logs whose behavior distribution only thinly covers the safety-critical tail; closed-loop reinforcement learning in a photorealistic simulator, while offering diverse behaviors, is bottlenecked by sample-efficiency, per-step cost of rendering, and a forward pass through a large vision backbone. Self-play in vectorized simulators changes the economics: at millions of rollout steps per second, one can obtain a state distribution with natural diversity in collisions, near-misses, and recoveries that no driving log contains, and a highly reactive policy emerges from a basic driving-quality reward. Our approach exploits this asymmetry. We pretrain a single policy by self-play, distill its rollouts into a flow-matching trajectory teacher that also plans, and train lightweight adapters on a frozen pretrained vision backbone to reproduce the latent space of either teacher through the action KL divergence, a batch-relational low-rank structural loss, and, for the planner, a trajectory-matching loss. Every target traces back to the self-play policy, so alignment never supervises against a logged trajectory: a paired dataset of (image, scene-state) frames suffices, with no need for the curated expert demonstrations that imitation pretraining is built on. From this one self-play teacher we obtain two end-to-end students: a closed-loop policy that outperforms every published imitation-based end-to-end method on the photorealistic 3D Gaussian splatting closed-loop benchmark HUGSim, and a planner that reaches 59.4 EPDMS on NAVSIM navhard, above every published method including DriveZero-Scale (57.1), and 95.5 PDMS on navtest, without human demonstrations.
papers.title_ja: TerraTransfer++: デモなしのエンドツーエンドプランナー
papers.summary_ja: 自律走行のエンドツーエンド学習において、高コストな模倣学習やクローズドループ強化学習の課題を解決するため、ベクトル化シミュレータでのセルフプレイによる事前学習手法を提案する。セルフプレイで得られた多様な状態分布からフローマッチング教師モデルを構築し、凍結したビジョンバックボーン上に軽量アダプタを訓練することで、人間によるデモデータなしで高品質なポリシーとプランナーを生成する。このアプローチにより、フォトリアリスティックな3DガウススプラッティングベンチマークHUGSimで既存の模倣学習手法を上回る性能を達成し、NAVSIMでも人間デモなしで最良の結果を記録した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とエージェント設計の手法は関心だが、分野が自律走行であり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
papers.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. This design makes action prediction depend directly on the quality of these future representations. In this paper, we introduce Future REpresentation learning via self-Distillation with temporal context (FRED), a framework that trains WAMs to improve the quality of future video representations from noise in a single denoising step. Specifically, FRED uses self-distillation to predict future representations from noise, using representations extracted from ground-truth future observations as targets. We further condition the video model on historical observations, providing temporal context for predicting future representations better. Across diverse real-world manipulation scenarios, FRED consistently outperforms competing WAMs. It achieves particularly large gains on long-horizon and out-of-domain tasks under zero-shot environment generalization, and substantially improves human-to-robot skill transfer, reaching 50.0% task success on tasks absent from robot training data and demonstrated only in human videos, compared with 19.4% for the best competing WAM.
papers.title_ja: ワールドアクションモデルのための自己蒸留による未来動画表現の学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、事前学習済み動画拡散モデルを活用したロボット制御手法「ワールドアクションモデル（WAM）」の推論効率化と性能向上を提案する。単一のデノイジングステップで抽出される未来動画表現の品質を、自己蒸留と時間的コンテキストの条件付けにより改善するフレームワーク「FRED」を導入した。これにより、反復的なデノイジングを回避しつつ、長期的タスクやゼロショット環境汎化におけるタスク成功率を大幅に向上させた。特に人間動画からロボットへのスキル転移において、競合手法を大きく上回る50.0%の成功率を達成した。

papers.title: MPBRS: Multi-Potential-Based Reward Shaping for Unified Reward Configuration in Humanoid Locomotion
papers.summary: Designing and tuning reward functions remains one of the main challenges in building effective reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines for humanoid locomotion. While shaping rewards can accelerate learning, naively formulated terms often conflict with the desired behavior, overfit to a specific robot, or become unstable under small weight changes. Potential-Based Reward Shaping (PBRS) offers an alternative solution: shaping the reward via differences of a potential function to guide exploration without changing the optimal policy. In this paper, we study Multi-PBRS for humanoid locomotion and propose a unified reward configuration. We then evaluate the same reward structure and weights across nine humanoid robots, requiring only robot-specific metadata (joint/link mappings and default poses) rather than per-robot reward redesign. Our experiments show that, compared to standard shaping, MPBRS provides more consistent scaling behavior and reduced tuning sensitivity across robots, making it easier to tune without altering the optimal policy.
papers.title_ja: MPBRS: 人型ロボットの歩行における統一報酬設定のための多ポテンシャルベース報酬整形
papers.summary_ja: 人型ロボットの強化学習における報酬関数の設計とチューニングの難題に対し、ポテンシャルベース報酬整形（PBRS）を拡張したMPBRS手法を提案する。この手法は、ロボットの固有メタデータのみで統一された報酬設定を可能にし、個別の報酬再設計を不要にする。9種類のロボットでの評価により、標準的な整形手法よりも一貫性のあるスケーリング特性とチューニング感度の低減が示された。
